skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description: Hirara utilizes her twin fans to execute drag-to-merge combo skills. Casting combo skills consumes Crimson Energy charges.
skills.tips: Energy management is critical; always monitor your Crimson Energy count.

skills.name: Kaerazu
skills.description: Hirara strikes with her primary fan, unleashing a flame wave that deals physical damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
skills.tips: Use this skill for fast jungle clearing and poke damage.

skills.name: Meisen-e
skills.description: Hirara dashes in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies along the path.
skills.tips: This is your main mobility tool; use it to dodge key crowd control skills.

skills.name: Infernal Torrent
skills.description: Hirara merges her twin fans, dashing forward and spinning to deal heavy circular burst damage to all nearby enemies.
skills.tips: Initiate with this combo when the enemy team is grouped to maximize AoE burst.

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Increases Physical Defense and Movement Speed.

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.des: Deals physical penetration and increases Movement Speed on skill hits.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Boosts shield absorption and HP regen effects.

items.name: Queen's Wings
items.des: Reduces damage taken when HP is low and grants lifesteal.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Resurrects hero 2.5s after dying, granting shield and HP.

builds.tips: Standard builds prioritize cooldown reduction, penetration, and durability for role-specific survival.

synergy.name: Angela
synergy.tips: Hirara has high damage output in the early-to-mid game, but the delay in her skills makes landing them less consistent. Hirara works especially well with strong early-game heroes with CC, such as Angela and Minotaur, allowing her to build an early advantage more easily.

counters.name: Saber
counters.tips: Excels against Saber in early game lane trades and isolates them effectively in teamfights.

countered_by.name: Hanzo
countered_by.tips: However, while Hirara is quick and nimble, she is also quite fragile. Against burst Assassins with targeted abilities, such as Saber and Natalia, it can be difficult to predict their attacks and use her 2nd + 1st Combo Skill in time. If she gets caught, she'll be taken down instantly.
